title: Rails
tagline: “Route maps for Ethereum” – Rails visualises transactions on Ethereum
description: Rails is a web application that educates and informs new and existing users, giving them confidence to use the Ethereum network. It helps to solve problems of understanding, trust and uncertainty by providing transparency to network activity. It achieves this by explaining onchain events with simple language and interactive, graphical map-like visualisations rendered from verifiable activity. Rails also serves as a tool for developers to support and educate their users.
